Subject: Need help with a divorce by mutual consent case

Hello, my name is Harish DSouza. I am a 72-year-old hardware dealer living in Nashik. My spouse Kavya Bhosale and I want a divorce by mutual consent with a settlement of INR 88,40,000/-, and the wife wants her jewellery and gifts returned. My case number is Petition No. 273/2025 in the Family Court at Nashik. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on 99076 54030 or email harish.dsouza@example.in.
